Detailed Analysis

Hinduja Tech (HT), part of the multi-billion-dollar global business conglomerate, Hinduja Group, provides product and digital engineering solutions. The services are catered to the disruptive mobility segment, especially in the electric and autonomous space. Hinduja Tech’s product engineering services division has inherited decades of automotive product development expertise in our DNA, and we offer full vehicle and powertrain development services from concept through SOP for ICE vehicles and EVs. Headquartered in Chennai, Hinduja Tech has pioneered automotive product co-development using its unique ‘Frugal EngiNEARing Paradigm’ with a strong focus on 'zero-based design to cost process' and delivered award-winning programs. Focused on the automotive industry, Hinduja Tech’s digital technologies services & solution division is a co-innovation partner for SAP/ERP services and offers enterprise mobility services, full stack IT development, testing, and maintenance using its own agile development methodology and accelerators. Our 100+ client list includes Top Global Auto OEMs, leading disruptive and emerging OEMs, & Global Tiers in Asia, North America, Europe and the Middle East. Hinduja Tech is strengthened by its subsidiaries: Drive System Design (DSD): Experts in electrified propulsion systems, transmission and driveline design, and energy efficiency improvements for hybrid and electric vehicles. https://www.drivesystemdesign.com/ TECOSIM Group: Pioneers in advanced simulation and clean energy solutions, catering to automotive, energy, and industrial sectors globally. https://tecosim.com/ Together, we drive excellence in sustainable mobility engineering. Office Location: India- Chennai, Bengaluru, Pune. North America- USA, Mexico, Canada. Europe- UK, France, Germany, Romania. Other countries- Australia, Japan.
